verses.original: וַיַּקְהֵ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·hêl mō·šeh ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh la·‘ă·śōṯ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: Then Moses assembled the whole congregation . . . of Israel and said to them These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO Moisés convocou toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e disse-lhes: Estas são as palavras que o SENHOR ordenou que se cumprissem.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־ הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה ב֛וֹ מְלָאכָ֖ה יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm tê·‘ā·śeh mə·lā·ḵāh ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î yih·yeh lā·ḵem qō·ḏeš šab·baṯ šab·bā·ṯō·wn Yah·weh kāl- hā·‘ō·śeh ḇōw mə·lā·ḵāh yū·māṯ
verses.literal: For six days work may be done but the seventh day shall be your holy day a Sabbath of complete rest to the LORD Whoever does any work on that day must be put to death
verses.literalPt: Seis dias se trabalhará, mas o sétimo dia vos será santo, o sábado do repouso ao SENHOR; todo aquele que nele fizer qualquer trabalho morrerá.

verses.original: לֹא־ תְבַעֲר֣וּ אֵ֔שׁ בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּי֖וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯə·ḇa·‘ă·rū ’êš bə·ḵōl mō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ
verses.literal: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day
verses.literalPt: Não acendereis fogo em nenhuma das vossas moradas no dia do sábado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Moses also told the whole congregation . . . of Israel This . . . is what the LORD . . . has commanded
verses.literalPt: Falou mais Moisés a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Esta é a palavra que o SENHOR ordenou, dizendo:

verses.original: קְח֨וּ מֵֽאִתְּכֶ֤ם תְּרוּמָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כֹּ֚ל נְדִ֣יב לִבּ֔וֹ יְבִיאֶ֕הָ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḥū mê·’it·tə·ḵem tə·rū·māh Yah·weh kōl nə·ḏîḇ lib·bōw yə·ḇî·’e·hā ’êṯ tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: Take from among you an offering to the LORD Let everyone whose heart is willing bring an offering to the LORD gold silver and bronze
verses.literalPt: Tomai do que tendes, uma oferta para o SENHOR; cada um, cujo coração é voluntariamente disposto, a trará por oferta alçada ao SENHOR: ouro, prata e cobre,

verses.original: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš wə·‘iz·zîm
verses.literal: blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . fine linen and goat hair
verses.literalPt: Como também azul, púrpura, carmesim, linho fino, pêlos de cabras,

verses.original: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׂטִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·rōṯ ’ê·lim mə·’ād·dā·mîm wə·‘ō·rōṯ tə·ḥā·šîm wa·‘ă·ṣê śiṭ·ṭīm
verses.literal: ram skins dyed red and fine leather acacia wood
verses.literalPt: E peles de carneiros, tintas de vermelho, e peles de texugos, madeira de acácia,

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּא֑וֹר וּבְשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·še·men lam·mā·’ō·wr ū·ḇə·śā·mîm lə·še·men ham·miš·ḥāh wə·liq·ṭō·reṯ has·sam·mîm
verses.literal: olive oil for the light spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense
verses.literalPt: E azeite para a luminária, e especiarias para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático.

verses.original: וְאַ֨בְנֵי־ שֹׁ֔הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפ֖וֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·nê- šō·ham wə·’aḇ·nê mil·lu·’îm lā·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ wə·la·ḥō·šen
verses.literal: and onyx stones . . . and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece
verses.literalPt: E pedras de ônix, e pedras de engaste, para o éfode e para o peitoral.

verses.original: וְכָל־ חֲכַם־ לֵ֖ב בָּכֶ֑ם יָבֹ֣אוּ וְיַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ bā·ḵem yā·ḇō·’ū wə·ya·‘ă·śū ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Let every skilled craftsman . . . among you come and make everything that the LORD has commanded
verses.literalPt: E venham todos os sábios de coração entre vós, e façam tudo o que o SENHOR tem mandado;

verses.original: אֶת־ הַ֨מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן אֶֽת־ אָהֳל֖וֹ וְאֶת־ מִכְסֵ֑הוּ אֶת־ קְרָסָיו֙ וְאֶת־ קְרָשָׁ֔יו אֶת־ בְּרִיחָ֕ו אֶת־ עַמֻּדָ֖יו וְאֶת־ אֲדָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān ’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lōw wə·’eṯ- miḵ·sê·hū ’eṯ- qə·rā·sāw wə·’eṯ- qə·rā·šāw ’eṯ- bə·rī·ḥå̄w ’eṯ- ‘am·mu·ḏāw wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḏā·nāw
verses.literal: the tabernacle with its tent and covering its clasps and frames its crossbars posts and bases
verses.literalPt: O tabernáculo, a sua tenda e a sua coberta, os seus colchetes e as suas tábuas, as suas barras, as suas colunas, e as suas bases;

verses.original: אֶת־ הָאָרֹ֥ן וְאֶת־ בַּדָּ֖יו אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֑רֶת וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- hā·’ā·rōn wə·’eṯ- bad·dāw ’eṯ- hak·kap·pō·reṯ wə·’êṯ pā·rō·ḵeṯ ham·mā·sāḵ
verses.literal: the ark with its poles and mercy seat and the veil to shield it
verses.literalPt: A arca e os seus varais, o propiciatório e o véu de cobertura,

verses.original: אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן וְאֶת־ בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān wə·’eṯ- bad·dāw wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·’êṯ le·ḥem hap·pā·nîm
verses.literal: the table with its poles all its utensils and the Bread of the Presence
verses.literalPt: A mesa e os seus varais, e todos os seus pertences; e os pães da proposição,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מְנֹרַ֧ת הַמָּא֛וֹר וְאֶת־ כֵּלֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־ נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- mə·nō·raṯ ham·mā·’ō·wr wə·’eṯ- kê·le·hā wə·’eṯ- nê·rō·ṯe·hā wə·’êṯ še·men ham·mā·’ō·wr
verses.literal: the lampstand for light with its accessories and lamps and oil for the light
verses.literalPt: E o candelabro da luminária, e os seus utensílios, e as suas lâmpadas, e o azeite para a luminária,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מִזְבַּ֤ח הַקְּטֹ֙רֶת֙ וְאֶת־ בַּדָּ֔יו וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֶת־ מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לְפֶ֥תַח הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- miz·baḥ haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ wə·’eṯ- bad·dāw wə·’êṯ še·men ham·miš·ḥāh wə·’êṯ qə·ṭō·reṯ has·sam·mîm wə·’eṯ- mā·saḵ hap·pe·ṯaḥ lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: the altar of incense with its poles the anointing oil and fragrant incense the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: E o altar do incenso e os seus varais, e o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático, e a cortina da porta para a entrada do tabernáculo,

verses.original: אֵ֣ת׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֗ה וְאֶת־ מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ אֶת־ בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־ כַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- miḵ·bar han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer- lōw ’eṯ- bad·dāw wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw ’eṯ- hak·kî·yōr wə·’eṯ- kan·nōw
verses.literal: the altar of burnt offering . . . with its bronze - grate its poles and all its utensils the basin with its stand
verses.literalPt: O altar do holocausto, e o crivo de cobre, os seus varais, e todos os seus pertences, a pia e a sua base,

verses.original: אֵ֚ת קַלְעֵ֣י הֶחָצֵ֔ר אֶת־ עַמֻּדָ֖יו וְאֶת־ אֲדָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ qal·‘ê he·ḥā·ṣêr ’eṯ- ‘am·mu·ḏāw wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḏā·ne·hā wə·’êṯ mā·saḵ ša·‘ar he·ḥā·ṣêr
verses.literal: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard
verses.literalPt: As cortinas do pátio, as suas colunas e as suas bases, e o reposteiro da porta do pátio,

verses.original: אֶת־ יִתְדֹ֧ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת־ יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר וְאֶת־ מֵיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- yiṯ·ḏōṯ ham·miš·kān wə·’eṯ- yiṯ·ḏōṯ he·ḥā·ṣêr wə·’eṯ- mê·ṯə·rê·hem
verses.literal: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard along with their ropes
verses.literalPt: As estacas do tabernáculo, e as estacas do pátio, e as suas cordas,

verses.original: אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê haś·śə·rāḏ lə·šā·rêṯ baq·qō·ḏeš ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê haq·qō·ḏeš lə·’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên wə·’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê ḇā·nāw lə·ḵa·hên
verses.literal: and the woven garments for ministering in the holy place both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests
verses.literalPt: As vestes do ministério para ministrar no santuário, as vestes santas de Arão o sacerdote, e as vestes de seus filhos, para administrarem o sacerdócio.

verses.original: וַיֵּֽצְא֛וּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִלִּפְנֵ֥י מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mil·lip̄·nê mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then the whole congregation . . . of Israel withdrew from the presence of Moses
verses.literalPt: Então toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel saiu da presença de Moisés,

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ כָּל־ אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֑וֹ וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נָדְבָ֨ה רוּח֜וֹ אֹת֗וֹ הֵ֠בִיאוּ אֶת־ תְּרוּמַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה לִמְלֶ֨אכֶת אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּלְכָל־ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ וּלְבִגְדֵ֖י הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū kāl- ’îš ’ă·šer- nə·śā·’ōw lib·bōw wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer nā·ḏə·ḇāh rū·ḥōw ’ō·ṯōw hê·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh lim·le·ḵeṯ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·lə·ḵāl- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw ū·lə·ḇiḡ·ḏê haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: And everyone . . . whose heart stirred him and whose spirit prompted him came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting for all its services and for the holy garments
verses.literalPt: E veio todo o homem, a quem o seu coração moveu, e todo aquele cujo espírito voluntariamente o excitou, e trouxeram a oferta alçada ao SENHOR para a obra da tenda da congregação, e para todo o seu serviço, e para as vestes santas.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים עַל־ הַנָּשִׁ֑ים כֹּ֣ל׀ נְדִ֣יב לֵ֗ב הֵ֠בִיאוּ חָ֣ח וָנֶ֜זֶם וְטַבַּ֤עַת וְכוּמָז֙ כָּל־ כְּלִ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְכָל־ אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵנִ֛יף תְּנוּפַ֥ת זָהָ֖ב לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū hā·’ă·nā·šîm ‘al- han·nā·šîm kōl nə·ḏîḇ lêḇ hê·ḇî·’ū ḥāḥ wā·ne·zem wə·ṭab·ba·‘aṯ wə·ḵū·māz kāl- kə·lî zā·hāḇ wə·ḵāl ’îš ’ă·šer hê·nîp̄ tə·nū·p̄aṯ zā·hāḇ Yah·weh
verses.literal: So all who had willing hearts both men and women came and brought brooches and earrings rings and necklaces and all kinds of gold jewelry And they all . . . presented their gold as a wave offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim vieram homens e mulheres, todos dispostos de coração; trouxeram fivelas, e pendentes, e anéis, e braceletes, todos os objetos de ouro; e todo o homem fazia oferta de ouro ao SENHOR;

verses.original: וְכָל־ אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ נִמְצָ֣א אִתּ֗וֹ תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ וְעִזִּ֑ים וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ’îš ’ă·šer- nim·ṣā ’it·tōw tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš wə·‘iz·zîm wə·‘ō·rōṯ ’ê·lim mə·’ād·dā·mîm wə·‘ō·rōṯ tə·ḥā·šîm hê·ḇî·’ū
verses.literal: Everyone . . . who . . . had blue purple or scarlet yarn . . . or fine linen goat hair ram skins dyed red or articles of fine leather . . . brought them
verses.literalPt: E todo o homem que se achou com azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho fino, e pêlos de cabras, e peles de carneiro tintas de vermelho, e peles de texugos, os trazia;

verses.original: כָּל־ מֵרִ֗ים תְּר֤וּמַת כֶּ֙סֶף֙ וּנְחֹ֔שֶׁת הֵבִ֕יאוּ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א אִתּ֜וֹ עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֛ים לְכָל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mê·rîm tə·rū·maṯ ke·sep̄ ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ hê·ḇî·’ū ’êṯ tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer nim·ṣā ’it·tōw ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm lə·ḵāl mə·le·ḵeṯ hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh hê·ḇî·’ū
verses.literal: And all who could present an offering of silver or bronze brought it as a contribution to the LORD Also, everyone who had . . . acacia wood for any part of the service brought it
verses.literalPt: Todo aquele que fazia oferta alçada de prata ou de metal, a trazia por oferta alçada ao SENHOR; e todo aquele que possuía madeira de acácia, a trazia para toda a obra do serviço.

verses.original: וְכָל־ אִשָּׁ֥ה חַכְמַת־ לֵ֖ב בְּיָדֶ֣יהָ טָו֑וּ וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ מַטְוֶ֗ה אֶֽת־ הַתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וְאֶת־ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן אֶת־ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ’iš·šāh ḥaḵ·maṯ- lêḇ bə·yā·ḏe·hā ṭā·wū way·yā·ḇî·’ū maṭ·weh ’eṯ- hat·tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·gā·mān ’eṯ- tō·w·la·‘aṯ haš·šā·nî wə·’eṯ- haš·šêš
verses.literal: Every skilled . . . woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun blue purple or scarlet yarn . . . or fine linen
verses.literalPt: E todas as mulheres sábias de coração fiavam com as suas mãos, e traziam o que tinham fiado, o azul e a púrpura, o carmesim e o linho fino.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַ֨נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָשָׂ֥א לִבָּ֛ן אֹתָ֖נָה בְּחָכְמָ֑ה טָו֖וּ אֶת־ הָעִזִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nā·šîm ’ă·šer nā·śā lib·bān ’ō·ṯā·nāh bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh ṭā·wū ’eṯ- hā·‘iz·zîm
verses.literal: And all the skilled women . . . whose hearts were stirred spun the goat hair
verses.literalPt: E todas as mulheres, cujo coração as moveu em habilidade fiavam os pêlos das cabras.

verses.original: וְהַנְּשִׂאִ֣ם הֵבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֚ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם וְאֵ֖ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפ֖וֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nə·śi·’im hê·ḇî·’ū ’êṯ ’aḇ·nê haš·šō·ham wə·’êṯ ’aḇ·nê ham·mil·lu·’îm lā·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ wə·la·ḥō·šen
verses.literal: The leaders brought onyx stones and gemstones to mount on the ephod and breastpiece
verses.literalPt: E os príncipes traziam pedras de ônix e pedras de engastes para o éfode e para o peitoral,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַבֹּ֖שֶׂם וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁ֑מֶן לְמָא֕וֹר וּלְשֶׁ֙מֶן֙ הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hab·bō·śem wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·men lə·mā·’ō·wr ū·lə·še·men ham·miš·ḥāh wə·liq·ṭō·reṯ has·sam·mîm
verses.literal: as well as spices and olive oil for the light for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense
verses.literalPt: E especiarias, e azeite para a luminária, e para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático.

verses.original: כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֣ב לִבָּם֮ אֹתָם֒ לְהָבִיא֙ לְכָל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה הֵבִ֧יאוּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל נְדָבָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’îš wə·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer nā·ḏaḇ lib·bām ’ō·ṯām lə·hā·ḇî lə·ḵāl ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh hê·ḇî·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl nə·ḏā·ḇāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: So all the men and women of the Israelites whose hearts prompted them brought a freewill offering to the LORD for all the work that the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do
verses.literalPt: Todo homem e mulher, cujo coração voluntariamente se moveu a trazer alguma coisa para toda a obra que o SENHOR ordenara se fizesse pela mão de Moisés; assim os filhos de Israel trouxeram por oferta voluntária ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רְא֛וּ קָרָ֥א יְהוָ֖ה בְּשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־ אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl rə·’ū qā·rā Yah·weh bə·šêm bə·ṣal·’êl ben- ’ū·rî ḇen- ḥūr lə·maṭ·ṭêh yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Then Moses said to the Israelites . . . See the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri the son of Hur of the tribe of Judah
verses.literalPt: Depois disse Moisés aos filhos de Israel: Eis que o SENHOR tem chamado por nome a Bezalel, filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá.

verses.original: וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחָכְמָ֛ה בִּתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכָל־ מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·mal·lê ’ō·ṯōw rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh biṯ·ḇū·nāh ū·ḇə·ḏa·‘aṯ ū·ḇə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God with skill ability and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship
verses.literalPt: E o Espírito de Deus o encheu de sabedoria, entendimento, ciência e em todo o lavor,

verses.original: וְלַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַֽחַשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשֹׂ֛ת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·laḥ·šōḇ ma·ḥa·šā·ḇōṯ la·‘ă·śōṯ baz·zā·hāḇ ū·ḇak·ke·sep̄ ū·ḇan·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: to design artistic works in gold silver and bronze
verses.literalPt: E para criar invenções, para trabalhar em ouro, e em prata, e em cobre,

verses.original: וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּכָל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת מַחֲשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥă·rō·šeṯ ’e·ḇen lə·mal·lōṯ ū·ḇa·ḥă·rō·šeṯ ‘êṣ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bə·ḵāl mə·le·ḵeṯ ma·ḥă·šā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: to cut gemstones for settings and to carve wood so that he may be a master of every artistic craft
verses.literalPt: E em lapidar de pedras para engastar, e em entalhar madeira, e para trabalhar em toda a obra esmerada.

verses.original: וּלְהוֹרֹ֖ת נָתַ֣ן בְּלִבּ֑וֹ ה֕וּא וְאָֽהֳלִיאָ֥ב בֶּן־ אֲחִיסָמָ֖ךְ לְמַטֵּה־ דָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·hō·w·rōṯ nā·ṯan bə·lib·bōw hū wə·’ā·ho·lî·’āḇ ben- ’ă·ḥî·sā·māḵ lə·maṭ·ṭêh- ḏān
verses.literal: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan the ability to teach others
verses.literalPt: Também lhe dispôs o coração para ensinar a outros; a ele e a Aoliabe, o filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã.

verses.original: מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜ם חָכְמַת־ לֵ֗ב לַעֲשׂוֹת֮ כָּל־ מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ׀ וְחֹשֵׁב֒ וְרֹקֵ֞ם בַּתְּכֵ֣לֶת וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּתוֹלַ֧עַת הַשָּׁנִ֛י וּבַשֵּׁ֖שׁ וְאֹרֵ֑ג עֹשֵׂי֙ כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֔ה וְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י מַחֲשָׁבֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: mil·lê ’ō·ṯām ḥā·ḵə·maṯ- lêḇ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ḥā·rāš wə·ḥō·šêḇ wə·rō·qêm bat·tə·ḵê·leṯ ū·ḇā·’ar·gā·mān bə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ haš·šā·nî ū·ḇaš·šêš wə·’ō·rêḡ ‘ō·śê kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh wə·ḥō·šə·ḇê ma·ḥă·šā·ḇōṯ
verses.literal: He has filled them with skill . . . to do all kinds of work as engravers designers embroiderers in blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and fine linen and as weavers as artistic designers . . . . . . of every kind of craft
verses.literalPt: Encheu-os de sabedoria do coração, para fazer toda a obra de mestre, até a mais engenhosa, e a do gravador, em azul, e em púrpura, em carmesim, e em linho fino, e do tecelão; fazendo toda a obra, e criando invenções.
